title: ForesightKV: Foresee Long-term KV Importance for Efficient Inference
one_line_claim: Predicts which KV pairs will be important to future tokens during generation and evicts unimportant pairs to enable aggressive compression.
method_summary: ForesightKV uses a two-stage training framework: Golden Eviction (supervised learning via pairwise ranking loss on attention patterns) predicts long-term KV importance, then GRPO (reinforcement learning on task performance) adapts this predictor to task-specific distributions. At generation time, the importance predictor selects which KV pairs to retain within a budget constraint.

key_findings.finding: Low-entropy tokens show dramatically amplified loss increases when evicted: +147% loss increase in Math, +75% in Code, +187% in Summarization tasks.
key_findings.quote: As shown in Table 1, evicting low-entropy tokens causes a larger loss increase compared to evicting random tokens (+147% for Math, +75% for Code, and +187% for Summarization).

key_findings.finding: Achieves 92-95% of full model performance at aggressive compression ratios (KV budget 2K-4K tokens) across multiple model sizes and tasks.
key_findings.quote: ForesightKV achieves around 92-95% performance with KV budget 2K-4K, as shown in Figure 3.

key_findings.finding: End-to-end throughput improvements range from 2.69x to 9.79x on different GPU configurations while maintaining quality.
key_findings.quote: We achieve 2.69x-9.79x end-to-end throughput gain across different GPU configurations.

relation_to_herald.shared: Both address KV-cache compression failures: ForesightKV via learned eviction to prevent catastrophic quality drops; HERALD via logit-signal prediction to detect them. Both target long-context LLM inference with tight memory/latency budgets. Both operate during generation without modifying the base model.
differs_on: ForesightKV solves the *which tokens to evict* problem via learned importance prediction; HERALD solves the *when failure will occur* problem via per-token logit features and forecasting.
ForesightKV trains an importance predictor end-to-end with task rewards; HERALD trains an XGBoost classifier on zero-cost logit statistics.
ForesightKV optimizes for task performance under a KV budget; HERALD optimizes for early detection of looping, non-termination, and instruction amnesia.
